changeSet.author: osmontero
changeSet.comment: Coordinate-map charts render their base tiles from a cross-origin https:// img, which the nginx Content-Security-Policy img-src governs. The CSP allows *.tile.openstreetmap.org and *.tile.thunderforest.com (the panel's preferred hosts, per product decision - not .fr). The seeded map charts (6 compliance in 20250127001/20250227001 + 3 gap dashboards in 20261012002) baked in the openstreetmap.fr tile URL, so they requested a host the CSP does not allow -> blank tiles. Flip any stored map chart_config from openstreetmap.fr/hot/ to openstreetmap.org/ so the tile request matches the CSP allow-list. Idempotent: REPLACE is a no-op once no .fr remains (guarded by LIKE).
changeSet.sql: UPDATE utm_visualization SET chart_config = REPLACE(chart_config, 'openstreetmap.fr/hot/', 'openstreetmap.org/') WHERE chart_type = 'COORDINATE_MAP_CHART' AND chart_config LIKE '%openstreetmap.fr%';
